text: Seamless Digital is the brand of Seamless Digital Ltd (UK company 13846251, Towcester; founder and CEO Mark Turner), whose Companies House persons-with-significant-control register names Seamless Digital Holdings Limited (no. 14628781) with 75% or more of its shares and voting rights and the right to appoint or remove directors. The Holdings company's own PSC register names two individuals, Mark Antony Castro Turner and Robert Rodrigues Decastro Turner, each with more than 25% but not more than 50% of shares and voting rights.
short: Seamless Digital is controlled by Seamless Digital Holdings Limited, owned by Mark Antony Castro Turner and Robert Rodrigues Decastro Turner.
